searchText: The refund would only be refunding gas that was already spent in the same tx Strawman version: * Original value of a field = 1 * You set it to 5: pay 5000 gas * You set it to 7: pay 100 gas (because already warm) * You set it back to 1: pay 100 gas, get 5000 refund Something like that should be very doable
